name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at South stair, west slip. direct left open. 8 steps. The drum stays for the start.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the drum at South stair. Nobody past the west slip. We start in 2 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: South stair west slip
speaker: Bess
line: South stair west slip. Bess keeps the drum for the start. 3 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
